question: Do the four no-abstract RL-for-KGQA papers already contain the idea's stepwise/one-hop repair mechanism or a hop-depth transfer result, which would raise overlap well above what the title-level analysis suggests?
description: Four of the eight highest-ranked retrieved papers on RL for multi-hop KGQA (doi:10.1016/j.eswa.2024.124652, doi:10.1016/j.ins.2022.11.042, doi:10.1016/j.knosys.2023.110760, doi:10.1145/3336191.3371812) returned no abstract from arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref, so their methods could not be verified from the indexed record. 'Stepwise reasoning with weak supervision' in particular is a plausible closest-work candidate for the idea's one-hop-failure repair loop, and any of them could already report hop-depth transfer.
rationale: These papers are among the highest-ranked by lexical relevance but were analyzed from titles only, so the current novelty assessment (U001) is based on an incomplete view of the RL branch.
